147:t_1:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$藤堂$$, report on the situation.」

147:t_1:5.en:
$$藤堂$$
「It has been a week since the battle at $$厳島$$, but the situation has only deteriorated.」

147:t_1:6.en:
$$藤堂$$
「Skirmishes with the Empire have occurred frequently nationwide this week. Low morale and a disrupted chain of command are increasing our losses.」

147:t_1:7.en:
$$扇$$
「But we haven't been defeated, have we?」

147:t_1:8.en:
$$藤堂$$
「We have won every battle, though only barely.」

147:t_1:9.en:
$$玉城$$
「Then shouldn't we be fine? We are winning, after all.」

147:t_1:11.en:
$$藤堂$$
「That attitude of yours is precisely what is dangerous, $$玉城$$.」

147:t_1:12.en:
$$玉城$$
「W-What do you mean by that?」

147:t_1:13.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Facing the threat of defeat sharpens people's focus and keeps their minds from wandering...」

147:t_1:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But even as losses raise their anxiety and frustration, victory numbs their sense of danger. They lose sight of their true situation...」

147:t_1:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And by the time they notice, they will have been driven into a situation beyond repair.」

147:t_1:16.en:
$$扇$$
「If you understand that, you could warn them...」

147:t_1:17.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It would only buy time. This slow decline feels so natural that nothing short of drastic measures is likely to stop it.」

147:t_1:18.en:
$$玉城$$
「You're saying this is the enemy's plan too?! Then we've fallen right into their trap!」

147:t_1:20.en:
$$玉城$$
「How can I be calm?! Do something, $$ゼロ$$!」

147:t_1:22.en:
$$玉城$$
「H-Hey...! Don't just go quiet on me!」

147:t_1:23.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Sooner or later, the enemy will launch a large-scale invasion of $$トウキョウ$$.」

147:t_1:24.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Winning that battle will be our only way to change the situation.」

147:t_1:26.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I do not lose. You should know that yourself.」

147:t_1:27.en:
$$玉城$$
「Yeah! Show us another miracle, $$ゼロ$$!」

147:t_1:29.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(It is simply a pure result of accumulated strategy and tactics, neither magic nor sleight of hand.)

147:t_1:30.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(But now that we're on the defensive in an overwhelmingly unfavorable situation, must I stake everything on a single decisive comeback...?)

147:t_1:32.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I've given that woman a separate assignment.」

147:t_1:33.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(I'm counting on you, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ The key to solving every mystery may be on that island.)

147:t_1:34.en:
$$千葉$$
「General $$藤堂$$, we have an emergency!」

147:t_1:36.en:
$$千葉$$
「We've just received word that the operation to capture $$セントラル・ベース$$ in North America has failed!」

147:t_1:38.en:
$$スザク$$
「But $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ was supposed to be taking part too...」

147:t_1:39.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(The $$新地球皇国$$... Is its power even greater than we imagined...?)

147:t_1:43.en: ～$$アッシュフォード学園$$ Main Gate～

147:t_1:44.en:
$n
「...So this is $$アッシュフォード学園$$, where $$カレン$$ and the others went...」

147:t_1:45.en:
$$カレン$$
「It's closed now because of the emergency, though.」

147:t_1:46.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But it's amazing. Not just $$沙慈$$ and $$ルイス$$, but Deputy Foreign Minister $$リリーナ$$ and the others were classmates too.」

147:t_1:47.en:
$$デュオ$$
「But that's not the best part. Believe it or not, $$紅月カレン$$ of the $$黒の騎士団$$ went here pretending to be a sickly young lady.」

147:t_1:50.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「That's way too much of a stretch!」

147:t_1:51.en:
$$カレン$$
「You guys are way too shocked!」

147:t_1:52.en:
$n
「Ah... Well... $$カレン$$... I-I'm glad you're healthier now.」

147:t_1:53.en:
$$カレン$$
「Don't you try to cover for me so badly either!」

147:t_1:54.en:
$$デュオ$$
「See? That's guaranteed to surprise anyone, right?」

147:t_1:55.en:
$$デュオ$$
「And at this school, there was $$ヒイロ$$ tearing up Miss $$リリーナ$$'s invitation, the mysterious $$ルルーシュ$$ with incredible athletic ability, and...」

147:t_1:57.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Oops, I'd better leave it there.」

147:t_1:58.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「That's right. We were assigned to investigate the situation in the city.」

147:t_1:59.en:
$$トロワ$$
「But the civilians are shut away in their homes.」

147:t_1:60.en:
$$カトル$$
「Until a week ago, the city was full of life even with the Empire closing in...」

147:t_1:61.en:
$$五飛$$
「So this is the result of $$サイデリアル$$'s plan wearing down the people's spirits...」

147:t_1:65.en:
$n
「Mind and body balance each other as one. When you're feeling down, just get your body moving.」

147:t_1:66.en:
$$カレン$$
「I've never heard that reasoning before...」

147:t_1:68.en:
$$カレン$$
「...All right. Looking at you makes me feel like believing it a little.」

147:t_1:70.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What you said just now... It had some weight to it.」

147:t_1:71.en:
$n
「Right? Even a sickly young lady can become a warrior feared as a demon or devil if she's fired up enough.」

147:t_1:72.en:
$$カレン$$
「You just had to say that last bit!」

147:t_1:73.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Then now that $$カレン$$ is back to normal, let's get back to our mission.」

147:t_1:74.en:
$$五飛$$
「The teams are as decided in the briefing. Patrol the city and meet in front of the school in two hours.」

147:t_1:76.en:
$$カレン$$
「What's wrong, $n? We're assigned to Block B.」

147:t_1:77.en:
$n
「...Sorry, $$カレン$$. Could you go on ahead?」

147:t_1:80.en:
$$カレン$$
「A-All right. Then... Call my phone if anything happens.」

147:t_1:83.en:
???
「...Your nose is as keen as a dog's.」

147:t_1:85.en:
???
「Well, from this close, even a half-baked $$リアクター$$ would notice my presence.」
